details:
Q1: What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or feature — name it and describe the problem. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation — name the page or topic and what is missing.
C. Test or CI reliability — name the failing check or behavior.
Q2: What result should the change achieve?
Choices:
A. Fix a reproducible failure — provide the steps or a failing run. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Change behavior — describe the current and desired behavior.
C. Improve clarity — describe what readers currently misunderstand.
